eu-strategic-governance-and-external-rel.anchor: EU strategic governance and external relations
eu-strategic-governance-and-external-rel.staticDefinition: The European Council is the EU institution in which the heads of state or government of the member states set broad political priorities and strategic direction; this note uses that institutional anchor only to frame the recorded meeting agenda, not to assert unverified procedural details.

european-council-the-eu-institution-that.anchor: European Council: the EU institution that provides political direction and priorities to the Europea
european-council-the-eu-institution-that.staticDefinition: The European Council brings together EU member-state heads of state or government to set the Union’s general political directions and priorities. The supplied record supports its adoption of conclusions, but does not itself provide a detailed institutional or legal description.
